# Bringing Big Retail Ideas to Life

][32]
[Custom retail displays: Colorful pine tree displays made from recycled acrylic in a retail window]

## Creating Head-Turning Displays for Iconic Brands

Acrylic Design Associates creates head-turning retail displays, signage and other branded elements.

For nearly 50 years, we have built innovative and sustainable solutions for some of the world's
best-known brands.

## What We Do

Acrylic is in our name, but that's not all we do. We craft eye-catching fixtures, displays, LED
innovations and branded environments across any material.

## Materials

Regal Plastic stocks high-quality materials, including acrylic, polycarbonate, HDPE, PVC, and a
variety of specialty plastics, ideal for industrial, commercial, and custom fabrication needs.

[Example of Lexan Glazing]

### See Thru

Lexan and Acrylic see-thru materials provide strength, clarity, and versatility. Ideal for
protective barriers, windows, and displays, these materials combine transparency with durability.
Lexan offers impact resistance for high-stress applications, while Acrylic provides excellent
clarity and UV resistance.

[Nylon Gear]

### Mechanical

Our range of mechanical plastics, including Acetal and Nylon, offers high-performance solutions for
wear-resistant and load-bearing applications. Known for their strength, low friction, and excellent
dimensional stability, these materials are ideal for parts like gears, bushings, and bearings.

[Cutting Boards]

### Industrial

Our industrial plastics range, featuring HDPE, UHMW, and LDPE, delivers chemical resistance, impact
strength, and durability. Designed for demanding applications, they excel in manufacturing,
agriculture, and construction.

[PVC-banner-material_edited_edited.jpg]

### Display

We offer a comprehensive range of display graphic substrates designed to meet the needs of the
signage, printing, and exhibit industries. Our high-quality plastic materials provide exceptional
printability, durability, and versatility, making them ideal for indoor and outdoor applications.

[Stiles-Holzma-HPP 130_edited.jpg]

## Our Services
* Cut-to-Size Plastics
* Plastic Routing, Machining & Fabrication
* Film Conversion

# Diseño, Análisis y Solución de problemas

La sencillez como compromiso

### Rápido y sencillo

Desde el portátil o la tableta, genera diagnósticos, métricas e informes

### Fácil de usar

Visualiza los resultados de forma intuitiva y faciles de entender

### Confiable

Elimina las caídas de la red WiFi y aumenta el rendimiento

### Análisis y resolución de problemas

### Sniffer avanzado

### SIGINT & GEOINT

[Acrylic Wi-Fi LEA][21]

### Análisis Bluetooth

[Acrylic BLE Analyzer][22]

Heatmaps

## Planificación y estudio del sitio

**Cubre** todas las **etapas del análisis** de una infraestructura wifi.
Diseño y planificación de cero, a la **evaluación** de una **red** ya **en funcionamiento**.
Pasando por la visualización de los resultados mediante gráficos y **métricas intuitivas** hasta la
generación de los **informes de resultados**.
* **Diseña y planifica** desde cero una red WiFi.
* **Site Survey**, **mapas de calor** de cobertura y calidad de red.
* Identifica y **soluciona** las **zonas problemáticas** de tu infraestructura.
* Genera **informes editables.**, guarda los proyectos y evidencias
* Soporte de **WiFi 7** en todas las bandas de frecuencia

**Y muchas más funcionalidades...**

Puntos de acceso Dispositivos Calidad Resolución

Analyzer

## Análisis y resolución de problemas

**Analiza** que esta ocurriendo en tu red wifi, **ejecuta métricas** y mide su rendimiento.
**Resuelve incidencias** y obtén **recomendaciones** de mejora.
Diseño sencillo y **fácil **de usar, moderno **e intuitivo** que ayuda a los usuarios menos
experimentados.
* **Analiza** tu red, **identifica** los clientes, mide el **rendimiento**, todo el tiempo real
* **Solución de problemas** y recomendaciones. Olvídate de conexiones lentas.
* Detecta **APs y dispositivos** (Routers, tabletas, teléfonos, portátiles, …)
* Soporte de **WIFI 7** en todas las **bandas de frecuencia**

**Y muchas más funcionalidades...**

[ Descubre Acrylic Wi-Fi Analyzer ][25] [ Comprar licencia ][26]

Sniffer

## Captura de paquetes mejorada

**Captura** todos los **paquetes wifi** enviados por los dispositivos a tu alrededor.
**Analiza** el protocolo y el funcionamiento **a bajo nivel** de las comunicaciones inalambricas.
El **complemento** perfecto para Acrylic Wi-Fi **Analyzer**, **Heatmaps** y **Wireshark**.
* Modo monitor **mejorado**
* Utiliza **hardware económico** y común
* **Integración con terceros**. Usa tu software favorito
* **Sin complicaciones**. No se requiere configuración

**Y muchas más funcionalidades...**

[ Descubre Acrylic Wi-Fi Sniffer ][27] [ Comprar licencia ][28]

#### Los profesionales lo tienen claro:
#### Fácil de usar y con muchas funcionalidades avanzadas.

En todos nuestros almacenes diseñamos los nuevos despliegues wifi con **Acrylic Wi-Fi Heatmaps** y
lo usamos para validar el desempeño periódicamente en todas las instalaciones.

Klaus Andersen

Gestor de instalaciones e ingeniero de redes

Todos nuestros técnicos se apoyan en **Acrylic Wi-Fi Analyzer** para solucionar los problemas que
surgen en las redes inalámbricas de nuestros clientes.

Priya Chopra

Gerente, especialista en redes

Con **Acrylic Wi-Fi Sniffer** hemos podido monitorizar los clientes conectados a nuestras redes
inalámbricas e identificar los problemas de configuración a nivel de protocolo que teniamos.

Alex Miller

Administrador de redes

# **Trusted for Quality. Chosen for Speed.**

Akrylix turns concepts into reality — fast. Custom fabrication, scalable production, and reliable
delivery, even on the tightest timelines.

[Start Your Project][22]

##### what we do

# Our Services

From eye-catching retail displays to time-critical trade show builds, Akrylix delivers high-quality
acrylic solutions — fast.

Explore our most requested services below.

##### **POP & Retail Displays**

Custom acrylic displays engineered for retail impact — seasonal promos, product showcases, and
high-volume rollouts.

##### **Trade Show & Event Solutions**

Portable, durable, and custom-fit acrylic components for booths, exhibits, and branded installations
— built to impress and travel well.

##### **Rush & Specialty Projects**

Tight deadline? Unique specs? We specialize in fast-turn, one-off, and technically complex projects
that others can’t take on.

###### About us

## **Reliable. Responsive. Ready for Any Acrylic Project.**

At Akrylix, we specialize in delivering high-quality acrylic solutions — whether you need a one-off
prototype, a rush trade show display, or a long-term production partner — all made in the USA. Our
team combines speed, precision, and flexibility to meet your timeline and exceed expectations. If
it’s made from acrylic, we can make it — and deliver it fast.

###### working with us

# why choose us

##### **Fast Turnarounds Without Sacrificing Quality**

We specialize in hitting tight deadlines while maintaining the high standards your brand demands —
from one-off displays to full production runs.

[Explore Our Capabilities][23]

##### **Built Around Your Project — Not the Other Way Around**

Whether you’re starting with a sketch, a CAD file, or just an idea, we tailor the entire process to
your needs — from design to delivery.

[Who We Serve][24]

##### **Start With a Free, No-Obligation Quote**

Tell us what you need. We’ll guide you through the options and give you a clear quote — fast,
honest, and with zero pressure.

[Request A Quote][25]

###### how we help

At Akrylix, we help brands and builders turn ideas into reality — fast. From custom POP displays and
event structures to long-term production runs, we deliver precision acrylic solutions with the
speed, consistency, and craftsmanship your projects demand.

Proudly made in the USA and trusted by teams nationwide, we’re built to meet your deadlines —
whether you need one unit or thousands.

[What We Do][26]

About Us
At Anuman Engineering Industries, we are driven by a firm company policy that is centered on
quality, transparency, and customer satisfaction. We are a reliable manufacturer, supplier, and
trader of Polycarbonate Sheet, of various specifications. We are committed to delivering products
that meet the highest levels of durability and performance. Our ethical business conduct ensures
that we establish long-term relationships with our clients, founded on trust and mutual respect. We
believe in constant improvement, constantly innovating our processes in order to stay ahead of the
game when it comes to industry trends and changing customer needs. Our policies also emphasize
environment responsibility, ensuring that our production systems are efficient and environmentally
friendly.

**Customer-Focused Approach**

Customer satisfaction is the driving force behind everything we do. We adhere to a customer-focused
approach, being extremely close to clients in terms of understanding their special requirements and
delivering tailor-made solutions that exceed expectations. Our professionally trained staff is
available to advise, assist in answering any queries, and ensure that every order is dispatched in a
timely and top quality fashion. Our intention is to supply an easeful process from initial enquiry
to post-sales assistance with competitive costs and economical answers enhancing our business
clientele. We are committed to creating long-term partnerships with our customers, assisting them in
achieving their objectives through trustworthy products and improved service.

**Warehouse and Inventory Management**

Our high-tech warehouse complex is an integral part of our cost-effective operations. We have a
systematic inventory of stocks so that we are able to hold tremendous quantities of Polycarbonate
Sheets with different specifications in order to dispatch different orders of our clients as fast as
possible. We have installed advanced automated handling and storage equipment at our warehouse that
allows for monitoring of the stocks at an efficient scale, effective optimization of the delivery
process, and secure stocking of products. With a solid inventory, we are in a position to make fast
deliveries, minimize lead times, and provide our customers with uninterrupted access to the products
they require when they require them.

How we work

## How we source for you

At ANWIN, we know that sourcing thirty low-value SKUs from eight different factories means eight
MOQs, eight lead times, three shipments and one person — you — chasing all of it. **That is why we
work as your single point of coordination, not as a factory pushing its own line ** We start from
your requirement, place each item with a supplier that actually fits it, check the goods before they
leave, and combine everything into one export order. You brief one team, and you receive one
shipment.

01

#### Requirement review

We review the product specification, target quantity, destination market, packaging and required
compliance documents before selecting a supplier.

02

#### Supplier & sample evaluation

We shortlist suitable manufacturers, compare capabilities and documents, and arrange samples for
your approval when required.

03

#### Order & quality control

Before production we confirm the approved product, packaging and inspection scope. Goods are checked
before dispatch against the agreed specification.

04

#### Consolidation & export

Products from approved suppliers are coordinated into one export plan, with packaging, shipping
documents and sea or air freight arranged for the order.

05

#### After-sales follow-up

After delivery, one account contact coordinates product feedback, claims and follow-up orders under
the agreed terms.

FAQ

## The questions we get most

Is BG Clear really free? What's the catch?
No catch. The tool is free for unlimited images, with no signup, no watermark, and no credit card.
We may add optional paid features later for batch jobs and API access, but the core background
remover stays free.
How good is the quality compared to remove.bg or Photoshop?
For most photos — products, portraits, pets, logos — the cutout quality is on par with paid tools.
Hair and fur are usually the toughest test, and our model holds up well there. For unusual edges
like fishnet or glass, you may still want a manual touch-up in the editor.
What file formats and sizes are supported?
You can upload JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WebP up to 10MB per image. The output is a transparent PNG at the
original resolution (we don't downscale).
Are my images private?
Yes. We process your image for you and don't resell it or use it to train anyone else's model. Files
are removed from temporary storage shortly after processing.
Can I use the cutouts commercially?
Yes — for ads, listings, ecom, client work, anything. You own the rights to the images you upload,
and the result is yours to use.
Does it work on mobile?
Yes. The whole tool runs in the browser on iOS, Android, and desktop. There's no app to install.

FAQ

## The questions we get most

Is BG Clear really free? What's the catch?
No catch. The tool is free for unlimited images, with no signup, no watermark, and no credit card.
We may add optional paid features later for batch jobs and API access, but the core background
remover stays free.
How good is the quality compared to remove.bg or Photoshop?
For most photos — products, portraits, pets, logos — the cutout quality is on par with paid tools.
Hair and fur are usually the toughest test, and our model holds up well there. For unusual edges
like fishnet or glass, you may still want a manual touch-up in the editor.
What file formats and sizes are supported?
You can upload JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WebP up to 10MB per image. The output is a transparent PNG at the
original resolution (we don't downscale).
Are my images private?
Yes. We process your image for you and don't resell it or use it to train anyone else's model. Files
are removed from temporary storage shortly after processing.
Can I use the cutouts commercially?
Yes — for ads, listings, ecom, client work, anything. You own the rights to the images you upload,
and the result is yours to use.
Does it work on mobile?
Yes. The whole tool runs in the browser on iOS, Android, and desktop. There's no app to install.

# **Welcome to Collins Plastics**

Established in 1982 and owned by Liam Collins, Collins Plastics design and fabricate a wide range of
plastic sheet products including display stands, brochure & window displays, collection boxes, menu
holders, signs, shop displays, machine guards etc.

We also provide specialised custom services for unique items where required. Located in purpose
built premises in Ballina, Co. Mayo, we offer a complete nationwide service from concept to the
finished project.

Products can be manufactured in a variety of materials including Acrylic, Foamex, PVC,
Polypropylene, Perspex, Lexan, Darvic, etc. The company policy of investment in the most modern
machinery available and staff training has led to the highest standard of workmanship.

After over 30 years in business, we have built a reputation for working as a partner with other
companies, and pride ourselves on developing new designs to suit various requirements.

[Collins Plastics Manufacturing]

## **New Flat Sheet Delivery Service**

Next Day, Nationwide Delivery Service of all Flat [**Plastic Sheeting **][21]on orders placed before
12 noon.
**[Polycarbonate][22], [Acrylic][23] and [PETG sheeting][24]** available from stock.

## **Manufacturing and Fabrication**

***We specialise in the manufacture and fabrication of products to our customers’ specification. 
The majority of our work is bespoke solutions designed specifically to meet the customer
requirement.***

## **Who We Are**

**Your Strategic Partner for Precision Acrylic Fabrication & Custom Retail Solutions**

[Our Workshop][Our Workshop]

Our Workshop

Based in Dongguan, Guangdong, we are a premier manufacturer specializing in high-precision acrylic
fabrication since 2012. Over the past decade, we have established ourselves as a strategic partner
for businesses worldwide, transforming complex design concepts into high-quality, bespoke acrylic
solutions. From custom retail displays and exhibition stands to personalized acrylic blocks and
furniture, our facility is engineered to handle projects of all scales with professional precision.
We are deeply experienced in managing international logistics, ensuring that your bespoke products
arrive securely and on schedule in the United States, Europe, Australia, and beyond.

**Comprehensive Acrylic Fabrication & Custom Solutions**

Our Dongguan facility features a comprehensive, state-of-the-art production line designed for
high-precision acrylic fabrication. By integrating advanced technology with skilled craftsmanship,
we ensure that every project—from simple displays to complex bespoke structures—meets the highest
industry standards. Our core capabilities include:

**Precision Cutting & Milling**: We utilize advanced laser cutting machines for intricate,
clean-edged designs and CNC machining centers to achieve complex shapes with high dimensional
accuracy.

**Professional Polishing**: We employ a variety of finishing techniques to ensure crystal clarity,
including diamond polishing machines for a superior edge, buffer wheel polishing machines for a
refined finish, and flame polishing machines for quick, high-gloss results.

**Custom Graphics & Branding**: Our facility is equipped with high-resolution UV printing machines
for vibrant, full-color designs and screen printing (silkscreen) equipment for durable, professional
logo and graphic application.

**Handcrafted Excellence**: Most of our display racks and acrylic boxes are meticulously assembled
and finished by skilled artisans, ensuring a premium aesthetic that mass-produced items cannot
match.

**Scalable OEM/ODM Solutions**: From raw material processing to final assembly, our streamlined
workflow maintains consistent quality and competitive pricing, allowing us to support both
small-batch prototypes and large-scale production runs without requiring high tooling costs.

**Partner With Us**

We are ready to support your next project with professional OEM/ODM manufacturing services. To
receive a prompt and accurate quote, please send us your detailed specifications, dimensions, and
quantity requirements. Our team looks forward to helping you achieve your goals with high-quality,
tailor-made acrylic solutions.

## **Who We Are**

**Your Strategic Partner for Precision Acrylic Fabrication & Custom Retail Solutions**

[Our Workshop][Our Workshop]

Our Workshop

Based in Dongguan, Guangdong, we are a premier manufacturer specializing in high-precision acrylic
fabrication since 2012. Over the past decade, we have established ourselves as a strategic partner
for businesses worldwide, transforming complex design concepts into high-quality, bespoke acrylic
solutions. From custom retail displays and exhibition stands to personalized acrylic blocks and
furniture, our facility is engineered to handle projects of all scales with professional precision.
We are deeply experienced in managing international logistics, ensuring that your bespoke products
arrive securely and on schedule in the United States, Europe, Australia, and beyond.

**Comprehensive Acrylic Fabrication & Custom Solutions**

Our Dongguan facility features a comprehensive, state-of-the-art production line designed for
high-precision acrylic fabrication. By integrating advanced technology with skilled craftsmanship,
we ensure that every project—from simple displays to complex bespoke structures—meets the highest
industry standards. Our core capabilities include:

**Precision Cutting & Milling**: We utilize advanced laser cutting machines for intricate,
clean-edged designs and CNC machining centers to achieve complex shapes with high dimensional
accuracy.

**Professional Polishing**: We employ a variety of finishing techniques to ensure crystal clarity,
including diamond polishing machines for a superior edge, buffer wheel polishing machines for a
refined finish, and flame polishing machines for quick, high-gloss results.

**Custom Graphics & Branding**: Our facility is equipped with high-resolution UV printing machines
for vibrant, full-color designs and screen printing (silkscreen) equipment for durable, professional
logo and graphic application.

**Handcrafted Excellence**: Most of our display racks and acrylic boxes are meticulously assembled
and finished by skilled artisans, ensuring a premium aesthetic that mass-produced items cannot
match.

**Scalable OEM/ODM Solutions**: From raw material processing to final assembly, our streamlined
workflow maintains consistent quality and competitive pricing, allowing us to support both
small-batch prototypes and large-scale production runs without requiring high tooling costs.

**Partner With Us**

We are ready to support your next project with professional OEM/ODM manufacturing services. To
receive a prompt and accurate quote, please send us your detailed specifications, dimensions, and
quantity requirements. Our team looks forward to helping you achieve your goals with high-quality,
tailor-made acrylic solutions.

E & T Plastics Mfg. Co., Inc. is where innovation meets precision in plastic fabrication and acrylic
solutions. With over 80 years of experience, we have established ourselves as a leader among plastic
distributors, delivering high-quality products and exceptional service to our clients.

## Our Products and Services

### Plastic Distribution Services

At E & T Plastics, we offer comprehensive [plastic distribution][161] for a wide range of plastic
products. We are committed to delivering precision and quality in every product that we offer.

### Acrylic Sheets

Our [transparent acrylic sheets][162] are ideal for a wide range of applications. Known for their
durability and versatility, our transparent acrylic sheet materials are crafted to meet the highest
standards of quality and reliability.

### Laser Cutting Services

E & T Plastics is acknowledged as a leader in laser cutting services for over 20 years. [Our
powerful CO2 lasers][163] can cut component parts with details in acrylic that routers simply cannot
match. With cutting power up to 2000 Watts, we can cut heavy gauge acrylic up to 1” thick. Our
lasers leave a beautiful, brilliant, highly polished edge even on parts with intricate detail. In
fact, even internal cutouts and holes achieve a high luster.

### Additional Services

[Our saw cutting services][164] enable us to cut your parts with precision accuracy, ensuring each
piece meets your exact specifications.

We also have Polishing services which add the finishing touch to your parts with the beauty of a
highly polished edge, enhancing both aesthetics and functionality.

We also offer CNC Routing with our six multi-head CNC routers equipped with tool-changing
capabilities, we guarantee precise fabrication of your designs. This advanced technology allows us
to handle complex projects efficiently and deliver high-quality results.

### Featured Services

[Featured Services][Featured Services]
* Laser Cutting – E & T Plastics is acknowledged as the leading manufacturer of non-metal laser cut
  components for over 20 years.
* Saw Cutting – Computerized Saws enables us to cut your parts with precision accuracy.
* Polishing – We can add the finishing touch to your parts with the beauty of a highly polished
  Edge.
* CNC Routing – We have six, multi-head CNC routers with tool-changing capabilities
[View All][165]

## Product Applications

E & T Plastics Mfg. Co., Inc. provides innovative plastic and acrylic solutions that cater to [a
diverse array of industries][166] and applications. Our products are trusted in:
* **Aerospace:** Our aerospace-grade acrylic materials are lightweight yet durable, making them
  ideal for high-performance components and structures. They offer excellent clarity and impact
  resistance, meeting stringent industry standards.
* **Corrosion Resistant:** Designed to withstand harsh environments, our corrosion-resistant acrylic
  sheets are perfect for applications requiring resistance to chemicals, moisture, and corrosion.
  They provide long-term durability and low maintenance, ensuring reliable performance in demanding
  conditions.
* **Display:** Our transparent acrylic sheets are widely used in the display industry for their
  superior optical clarity and versatility. Whether for retail displays, museum exhibits, or trade
  show booths, our acrylic materials enhance visibility and aesthetics, showcasing products and
  information with brilliance.
* **Food Processing:** Compliant with FDA regulations, our food-grade acrylic materials are safe for
  use in food processing environments. They offer smooth surfaces that are easy to clean, helping to
  maintain hygiene standards while providing durability and impact resistance.
* **Graphics:** Ideal for signage, visual communication, and artistic applications, our acrylic
  sheets offer vibrant colors and excellent printability. They are lightweight, easy to fabricate,
  and resistant to yellowing, ensuring long-lasting performance for indoor and outdoor graphics.
* **Security and Ballistics:** Our bullet-resistant acrylic sheets are engineered to provide
  superior protection against ballistic threats while maintaining optical cl

## Our Products and Services

### Plastic Distribution Services

At E & T Plastics, we offer comprehensive [plastic distribution][161] for a wide range of plastic
products. We are committed to delivering precision and quality in every product that we offer.

### Acrylic Sheets

Our [transparent acrylic sheets][162] are ideal for a wide range of applications. Known for their
durability and versatility, our transparent acrylic sheet materials are crafted to meet the highest
standards of quality and reliability.

### Laser Cutting Services

E & T Plastics is acknowledged as a leader in laser cutting services for over 20 years. [Our
powerful CO2 lasers][163] can cut component parts with details in acrylic that routers simply cannot
match. With cutting power up to 2000 Watts, we can cut heavy gauge acrylic up to 1” thick. Our
lasers leave a beautiful, brilliant, highly polished edge even on parts with intricate detail. In
fact, even internal cutouts and holes achieve a high luster.

### Additional Services

[Our saw cutting services][164] enable us to cut your parts with precision accuracy, ensuring each
piece meets your exact specifications.

We also have Polishing services which add the finishing touch to your parts with the beauty of a
highly polished edge, enhancing both aesthetics and functionality.

We also offer CNC Routing with our six multi-head CNC routers equipped with tool-changing
capabilities, we guarantee precise fabrication of your designs. This advanced technology allows us
to handle complex projects efficiently and deliver high-quality results.

* **Corrosion Resistant:** Designed to withstand harsh environments, our corrosion-resistant acrylic

  They provide long-term durability and low maintenance, ensuring reliable performance in demanding
  conditions.
* **Display:** Our transparent acrylic sheets are widely used in the display industry for their
  superior optical clarity and versatility. Whether for retail displays, museum exhibits, or trade
  show booths, our acrylic materials enhance visibility and aesthetics, showcasing products and
  information with brilliance.
* **Food Processing:** Compliant with FDA regulations, our food-grade acrylic materials are safe for

held in Duesseldorf, Germany. Consisting 71% of the international participants, "K Fair", which is

which is the most efficient coating material for greenhouses.

# Professional Sign & Construction  Materials Manufacturer

JUTU Technologies Ltd is a leading manufacturer of materials used for visual communication,
graphics, sign making, decoration and construction.  
The first company of JUTU Group was founded in the begining of 2003, which focused on selling
printing consumables for wide format digital printing systems. 
[ View More ][120]

## Comprehensive Range

A one-stop source for a wide variety of advertising consumables and rigid substrates, catering to
every scenario across signage, display, and decoration applications.
 

## Superior Performance

Featuring exceptional weather resistance, tensile strength, water resistance, and chemical
stability—ensuring that outdoor applications remain vibrant and look as good as new for years to
come.

## Eco-Conscious Leadership

Our entire product line utilizes non-toxic, low-emission formulations, with a strong emphasis on
recyclable and biodegradable materials.
 
 

## Globally Trusted

With over 500 export shipments to date, we have established stable global partnerships backed by
rigorous international certifications.

## FAQ's

### Frequently Asked Questions About LEXAN™

[What is LEXAN™ used for? ][77]

LEXAN™ is a high-quality polycarbonate material used in various applications, including roofing,
windows, machine guards, safety shields, automotive components, and signage. It is popular for its
impact resistance, transparency, and durability.

[ Is LEXAN™ stronger than glass? ][78]

Yes, LEXAN™ is significantly stronger than glass. It is up to 250 times more impact-resistant,
making it a preferred choice for applications where safety and durability are essential.

[ Is LEXAN™ better than acrylic? ][79]

LEXAN™ and acrylic serve similar purposes, but LEXAN™ offers higher impact resistance, greater
flexibility, and better heat resistance. While acrylic is more scratch-resistant, LEXAN™ is more
durable and can withstand higher impact forces without breaking.

[ How thick are LEXAN™ windows? ][80]

LEXAN™ windows come in various thicknesses, typically ranging from 1 mm to over 12 mm, depending on
the application. Custom thicknesses can be chosen based on the required strength and impact
resistance.

[ Is LEXAN™ weatherproof? ][81]

Yes, LEXAN™ is weatherproof. It resists UV rays, moisture, and extreme temperatures, making it ideal
for outdoor applications such as roofing, skylights, and protective barriers.

[ What is LEXAN™ made of? ][82]

LEXAN™ is made from high-quality polycarbonate resin, a thermoplastic material known for its
strength, clarity, and impact resistance.

[ Is LEXAN™ plastic strong? ][83]

Yes, LEXAN™ is an extremely strong plastic with high impact resistance. It can withstand significant
force without cracking or breaking, making it suitable for protective applications.

[ Is LEXAN™ bulletproof glass? ][84]

While standard LEXAN™ sheets are highly impact-resistant, bulletproof versions require multiple
layers combined with other materials. Bullet-resistant LEXAN™ is used in security windows, bank
teller shields, and military applications.

[ How long will LEXAN™ last? ][85]

LEXAN™ can last for decades with proper maintenance. It resists yellowing and degradation,
especially when coated with UV protection, ensuring long-term performance in outdoor and industrial
applications.

[ How does LEXAN™ Polycarbonate Sheet differ from other variants? ][86]

LEXAN™ Polycarbonate Sheets differ from other polycarbonate variants in terms of impact resistance,
optical clarity, and heat resistance. Some specialized LEXAN™ sheets offer enhanced UV protection,
anti-scratch coatings, or flame-retardant properties.

[ Is LEXAN™ breakable? ][87]

LEXAN™ is highly resistant to breakage. Unlike glass, which shatters upon impact, LEXAN™ bends and
absorbs impact without cracking, making it a safer and more durable alternative.

### Frequently Asked Questions About PLEXIGLAS®

[What is PLEXIGLAS® used for? ][88]

PLEXIGLAS® is a transparent acrylic sheet used in windows, displays, protective barriers, aquariums,
signage, and furniture. It is lightweight, durable, and shatter-resistant.

[ Is PLEXIGLAS® breakable? ][89]

PLEXIGLAS® is much stronger than glass but can break under extreme force. It is impact-resistant but
not as durable as polycarbonate materials like LEXAN™.

[ What is the difference between PLEXIGLAS® and acrylic? ][90]

PLEXIGLAS® is a type of acrylic plastic, but not all acrylics are PLEXIGLAS®. PLEXIGLAS® is
typically harder and more scratch-resistant than standard acrylic sheets.

[ Can PLEXIGLAS® withstand weight? ][91]

Yes, PLEXIGLAS® can support moderate weight, but its load-bearing capacity depends on thickness.
Thicker sheets are better suited for structural applications.

[ Is PLEXIGLAS® good for security? ][92]

PLEXIGLAS® provides moderate security and shatter resistance but is not as strong as polycarbonate
materials like LEXAN™ for high-impact protection.

[ Can PLEXIGLAS® catch fire? ][93]

PLEXIGLAS® is flammable and can catch fire at high temperatures. However, fire-rated versions are
available for enhanced safety.

[ What is the lifespan of PLEXIGLAS®? ][94]

PLEXIGLAS® can last for many years, typically 10-20 years, depending on exposure to UV rays and
environmental factors.

[ Is PLEXIGLAS® UV rated? ][95]

Many PLEXIGLAS® sheets have UV-resistant coatings, preventing yellowing and degradation from sun
exposure.

[ Is PLEXIGLAS® a glass or plastic? ][96]

PLEXIGLAS® is a plastic material made from polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA). It mimics the appearance
of glass but is much lighter and more impact-resistant.

[ Can PLEXIGLAS® sheet be used in roofing? ][97]

Yes, PLEXIGLAS® sheets can be used for roofing applications. They allow natural light transmission
and are often used in skylights and greenhouses, but polycarbonate may be a better choice for impact
resistance and durability.

## FAQ's

### Frequently Asked Questions About LEXAN™

[What is LEXAN™ used for? ][77]

LEXAN™ is a high-quality polycarbonate material used in various applications, including roofing,
windows, machine guards, safety shields, automotive components, and signage. It is popular for its
impact resistance, transparency, and durability.

[ Is LEXAN™ stronger than glass? ][78]

Yes, LEXAN™ is significantly stronger than glass. It is up to 250 times more impact-resistant,
making it a preferred choice for applications where safety and durability are essential.

[ Is LEXAN™ better than acrylic? ][79]

LEXAN™ and acrylic serve similar purposes, but LEXAN™ offers higher impact resistance, greater
flexibility, and better heat resistance. While acrylic is more scratch-resistant, LEXAN™ is more
durable and can withstand higher impact forces without breaking.

[ How thick are LEXAN™ windows? ][80]

LEXAN™ windows come in various thicknesses, typically ranging from 1 mm to over 12 mm, depending on
the application. Custom thicknesses can be chosen based on the required strength and impact
resistance.

[ Is LEXAN™ weatherproof? ][81]

Yes, LEXAN™ is weatherproof. It resists UV rays, moisture, and extreme temperatures, making it ideal
for outdoor applications such as roofing, skylights, and protective barriers.

[ What is LEXAN™ made of? ][82]

LEXAN™ is made from high-quality polycarbonate resin, a thermoplastic material known for its
strength, clarity, and impact resistance.

[ Is LEXAN™ plastic strong? ][83]

Yes, LEXAN™ is an extremely strong plastic with high impact resistance. It can withstand significant
force without cracking or breaking, making it suitable for protective applications.

[ Is LEXAN™ bulletproof glass? ][84]

While standard LEXAN™ sheets are highly impact-resistant, bulletproof versions require multiple
layers combined with other materials. Bullet-resistant LEXAN™ is used in security windows, bank
teller shields, and military applications.

[ How long will LEXAN™ last? ][85]

LEXAN™ can last for decades with proper maintenance. It resists yellowing and degradation,
especially when coated with UV protection, ensuring long-term performance in outdoor and industrial
applications.

[ How does LEXAN™ Polycarbonate Sheet differ from other variants? ][86]

LEXAN™ Polycarbonate Sheets differ from other polycarbonate variants in terms of impact resistance,
optical clarity, and heat resistance. Some specialized LEXAN™ sheets offer enhanced UV protection,
anti-scratch coatings, or flame-retardant properties.

[ Is LEXAN™ breakable? ][87]

LEXAN™ is highly resistant to breakage. Unlike glass, which shatters upon impact, LEXAN™ bends and
absorbs impact without cracking, making it a safer and more durable alternative.

### Frequently Asked Questions About PLEXIGLAS®

[What is PLEXIGLAS® used for? ][88]

PLEXIGLAS® is a transparent acrylic sheet used in windows, displays, protective barriers, aquariums,
signage, and furniture. It is lightweight, durable, and shatter-resistant.

[ Is PLEXIGLAS® breakable? ][89]

PLEXIGLAS® is much stronger than glass but can break under extreme force. It is impact-resistant but
not as durable as polycarbonate materials like LEXAN™.

[ What is the difference between PLEXIGLAS® and acrylic? ][90]

PLEXIGLAS® is a type of acrylic plastic, but not all acrylics are PLEXIGLAS®. PLEXIGLAS® is
typically harder and more scratch-resistant than standard acrylic sheets.

[ Can PLEXIGLAS® withstand weight? ][91]

Yes, PLEXIGLAS® can support moderate weight, but its load-bearing capacity depends on thickness.
Thicker sheets are better suited for structural applications.

[ Is PLEXIGLAS® good for security? ][92]

PLEXIGLAS® provides moderate security and shatter resistance but is not as strong as polycarbonate
materials like LEXAN™ for high-impact protection.

[ Can PLEXIGLAS® catch fire? ][93]

PLEXIGLAS® is flammable and can catch fire at high temperatures. However, fire-rated versions are
available for enhanced safety.

[ What is the lifespan of PLEXIGLAS®? ][94]

PLEXIGLAS® can last for many years, typically 10-20 years, depending on exposure to UV rays and
environmental factors.

[ Is PLEXIGLAS® UV rated? ][95]

Many PLEXIGLAS® sheets have UV-resistant coatings, preventing yellowing and degradation from sun
exposure.

[ Is PLEXIGLAS® a glass or plastic? ][96]

PLEXIGLAS® is a plastic material made from polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA). It mimics the appearance
of glass but is much lighter and more impact-resistant.

[ Can PLEXIGLAS® sheet be used in roofing? ][97]

Yes, PLEXIGLAS® sheets can be used for roofing applications. They allow natural light transmission
and are often used in skylights and greenhouses, but polycarbonate may be a better choice for impact
resistance and durability.

Customize your portrait, combine multiple pictures of your loved ones, your naughty pooch, and see
how it will look before you order. Let us know if you wish to rush through the order to receive it

## We obsess over the details to make every artwork just perfect.

Over the years we have curated images of our customers, made artworks based upon the images and
created a line of unique heirloom artworks bringing people separated by time, distance or
generations together. Just let us know the outfits, theme and backgrounds you love and you will be
amazed how the entire family can add up and live together in the portrait.
Family pictures should live on your walls, and not on a USB or photo album.

How many times have you wanted to stay with 'just the digitals pictures or photographs', with full
intention of printing or framing them, but never did?
Or never found a perfect picture of your family together, the kids didn't smile, someone moved or
blinked their eyes, everyone lived in different cities or your pet never stayed in one place to get
the perfect shot? We can combine the pictures and make the artwork look like the picture you always
wanted.

Preserving a Piece of History

"Now I’ll see the tree every day in my home." - Bill L

For over 50 years, Bill passed the Holy Oak, a 600-year-old white oak tree in Basking Ridge, NJ. It
wasn’t just historic. It was personal. When the tree was taken down in 2016, he wanted more than a
memory. He wanted to see it again every day. He shared a photo, room colors, and a vision: a
textured oil painting that would bring the tree back to life. Our artist honored every detail, from
the quiet cemetery beneath it to the warm tones of its final autumn. Now, the Holy Oak stands once
again, not outside a church, but on canvas, in Bill’s home.

## Get a free consultation

Customize your portrait, combine multiple pictures of your loved ones, your naughty pooch, and see
how it will look before you order. Let us know if you wish to rush through the order to receive it
by a particular date. Need suggestions on background? Or wish to give a unique gift skillfully
created only for the recipient? We are here to help.
* [Get free consultation][62]
* [Chat with us][63]

## We obsess over the details to make every artwork just perfect.

Over the years we have curated images of our customers, made artworks based upon the images and
created a line of unique heirloom artworks bringing people separated by time, distance or
generations together. Just let us know the outfits, theme and backgrounds you love and you will be
amazed how the entire family can add up and live together in the portrait.
Family pictures should live on your walls, and not on a USB or photo album.

How many times have you wanted to stay with 'just the digitals pictures or photographs', with full
intention of printing or framing them, but never did?
Or never found a perfect picture of your family together, the kids didn't smile, someone moved or
blinked their eyes, everyone lived in different cities or your pet never stayed in one place to get
the perfect shot? We can combine the pictures and make the artwork look like the picture you always
wanted.

[Read More][64]
* [CUSTOMER STORY 1][65]
* [CUSTOMER STORY 2][66]

Preserving a Piece of History

"Now I’ll see the tree every day in my home." - Bill L

For over 50 years, Bill passed the Holy Oak, a 600-year-old white oak tree in Basking Ridge, NJ. It
wasn’t just historic. It was personal. When the tree was taken down in 2016, he wanted more than a
memory. He wanted to see it again every day. He shared a photo, room colors, and a vision: a
textured oil painting that would bring the tree back to life. Our artist honored every detail, from
the quiet cemetery beneath it to the warm tones of its final autumn. Now, the Holy Oak stands once
again, not outside a church, but on canvas, in Bill’s home.

## What are Online PNG Tools?

Online PNG Tools are the Swiss army knife for all your PNG editing needs, designed to effortlessly
enhance and transform graphics. Whether you're looking to change colors, make a transparent PNG, or
convert PNG format, our intuitive interface promises instant previews and one-click downloads. You
can even chain multiple tools together for limitless editing possibilities—all while maintaining
100% data privacy.

[See All PNG Tools][27]

## How do Online PNG Tools work?

Online PNG Tools operate seamlessly within your browser, allowing you to swiftly edit and modify PNG
graphics without any additional installations. Simply drag your image to the left side input, and
like magic, watch your transformed image appear on the right side output. Additionally, all tools
prioritize user privacy, ensuring that all data modifications occur on your device without any
uploads to external servers.

## Who uses Online PNG Tools?

Online PNG Tools and other our products are trusted by a vast audience ranging from individual
graphic designers and web developers to photographers and digital artists and sellers on platforms
like Etsy and eBay. Not just confined to small and medium enterprises, even large corporations,
including renowned Fortune 100 companies are using them

  [Expand][Expand Hover]
  
  Yes! Creating a transparent background is one of our core features. Photiu.ai can quickly and

* ### Can Photiu.ai add a white background to my photos?
  
  [Expand][Expand Hover]
  
  Yes, absolutely! Replacing any cluttered backdrop with a crisp, studio-grade [**white background
  **][29] is one of our most popular features.
* ### Is this a free background remover tool?
  
  [Expand][Expand Hover]
  
  Yes, Photiu.ai offers a free service to all users, but with certain limitations. You can upload
  images and erase backgrounds for free, then save the edited pictures in preview quality. If you
  need high-definition (HD) resolution images, a small fee is required. For most everyday purposes,
  the free preview quality is usually sufficient.
* ### How can I change the background of a photo?
  
  [Expand][Expand Hover]
  
  With Photiu.ai, changing the background is simple. Select your photo, remove the background, then
  choose a new background from our library or upload your own. Download the final image in HD
  quality.
* ### Can I change the background color of my photo or use a custom image as a background?
  
  [Expand][Expand Hover]
  
  Yes, after removing the background, you can change the background color of your photo or use a
  custom image as a new background and download it in HD. If you want to change the background to a
  red background, you can access it quickly via [**Red Background **][30].
* ### Do I need any technical skills to use Photiu.ai?
  
  [Expand][Expand Hover]
  
  Not at all! Photiu.ai is designed to be user-friendly and accessible to everyone. You don’t need
  any special skills or software. Just upload your photo, and our AI-powered tool will take care of
  the background removal process for you.
* ### What file formats does Photiu.ai support?
  
  [Expand][Expand Hover]
  
  Photiu.ai supports a wide range of file formats, including JPG, JPEG, PNG, and WEBP. This ensures
  you can upload and process almost any image file without compatibility issues.
* ### Can I replace the removed background with a new one using Photiu.ai?
  
  [Expand][Expand Hover]
  
  Yes, after removing the background, Photiu.ai allows you to replace it with a new background. You
  can choose from our library of background templates or upload your own to create a unique look for
  your photo.
* ### Why should I use this online background eraser?
  
  [Expand][Expand Hover]
  
  Photiu.ai uses advanced algorithms to provide excellent background removal results, often
  outperforming similar tools on the market. Our platform is user-friendly and perfect for
  beginners, making it easy to get professional-quality edits.
* ### Can I remove the background from the logo image with this tool?
  
  [Expand][Expand Hover]
  
  Yes, but results may vary. Photiu.ai is optimized for images with a central subject and focus. For
  logo images, further editing with the in-app brush may be necessary to achieve perfect results.

## Plastic Fabrication Services

Plastics and polymers are incredibly versatile materials, something that we respect at
Polymershapes. As plastics suppliers, we offer nearly every possible material for companies in the
market for plastic fabrication.

We’re the top distributor and supplier of:
* Plastic sheeting
* Films
* Rods
* Tubes
* And many other similar plastic products.

Our ability to provide the plastic materials you need is just one of the reasons that we’ve been [a
leading plastic fabrication company in the industry for the past 70 years][112].

Polymershapes is your home for the fabrication of plastics and polymers like acrylic. Enjoy access
to our wide-ranging network of suppliers and stocking facilities at locations all across the
Americas. We think of ourselves as a one-stop shop for plastic fabrication, and we’re confident your
company will agree.

Talk to us about:
* [CAD design][113]

* Part assembly.

We can even help with tight deadlines and last-minute projects. At Polymershapes, our goal as a

plastics.

## Top Products

### [POP & Display][116]

At Polymershapes, we fabricate high-impact point-of-purchase displays designed to help your products
and services stand out.
* Complete POP plastic fabrication support in Los Angeles
* [Printing & graphics][117], [electric and non-printed signage ][118]handled in-house
* Trusted partner for plastic fabrication and manufacturer sourcing

With dozens of plastic polymer material types to choose from, we can create displays with the weight
and durability you’re looking for at our plastic fabrication company, even [blast-resistent
displays][119].

We can fabricate temporary, permanent, and semi-permanent displays.

Our POP and display capabilities include:
* Free-standing displays
* Bins, shelving, end caps, and product dispensers
* Kiosks, donor boards, and directories
* Stage sets, trade show booths, and exhibits
* Custom plastic fixtures for retail, office, and commercial environments

Talk with our plastic fabrication experts to define the right materials, design, and fabrication
method for your display. We’ll guide you every step of the way.

### [Aerospace Components][122]

Polymer plastics play a critical role in aerospace applications, offering clear advantages over
traditional metal components.
* Lightweight materials that help reduce overall aircraft weight
* Rust- and corrosion-resistant performance
* Easily fabricated into precise, application-specific shapes
* Heat-, flame-, and smoke-resistant polymer options available

Through our company, Polymershapes, plastic fabrication services, aerospace manufacturers can
leverage these benefits without sacrificing durability or longevity.

Common aerospace applications include:
* Cockpit instrument panels
* Cargo containers and beverage carts
* Interior and functional aircraft components
* Durable acrylic fabrication for cockpit windshields and cabin windows

Our plastic fabrication specialists can help your company determine how best to design and fabricate
them, as well as the best polymer plastic materials to meet your performance requirements.

[Aerospace Components][123] [Get A Quote][124]

Polymershapes can deliver.

We source plastics and polymers, like acrylic, from leading manufacturers worldwide and fabricate

get your plastic cut and shaped within 24-48 hours.

As a leading custom plastic fabrication company, all our material supplies meet NAFTA standards, are

# PNG Transparency Creator

This free tool lets you make any image background transparent. Upload a PNG or JPG image, pick the
background color to remove, adjust threshold and smoothing, and download your transparent PNG
instantly. Works entirely in your browser – no uploads needed.

### Input Image

Drag & drop or click to upload
Pick Color: Add Color
Threshold: 30% Smooth: Blur:
Undo Redo

### Output Image

Download PNG

## About PNG Transparency Creator

Ever needed to remove the background from an image but didn’t know where to start? Yeah, same here.
A lot of times it sounds easy — like “just remove the background” — but when you actually sit down
to do it, it’s a whole mess of complicated tools, expensive software, or confusing online websites.

That’s exactly why we built **PNG Transparency Creator** — a simple tool that lets you make any PNG
image transparent, right inside your browser. No downloads. No installations. Just upload your
image, pick the background color (or colors) you want gone, adjust a slider or two, and poof —
background removed.

### Why You Might Need This Tool

Transparent PNGs are everywhere. Ever notice how logos on websites don’t have weird white boxes
behind them? That’s because they use transparent images.

A transparent image means you can use it on:
* Websites
* YouTube thumbnails
* Social media posts
* Memes (of course)
* Business presentations
* Online shops and product listings

If your image still has a colored background, it sticks out like a sore thumb on a fancy webpage.
Transparent PNG solves that.

### How Does This PNG Transparency Tool Work?

Honestly, it’s super simple. Here’s the magic:
1. Upload your image on the left panel.
2. Click the background color you want to remove — like white, gray, green, whatever it is.
3. Adjust the **Threshold** slider to control how aggressive it should be. Low threshold = precise

## Wheel of Fortune 35th Anniversary Cake Topper

Wheel of Fortune’s Art team contacted Solter Plastics to design a memorable cake topper to
commemorate their 35 year anniversary of the show. 
We laser cut metallic gold and silver acrylic and laminated to a frosted clear background.

## Luxury Lucite Dining Table

Our customer Ann had a vision of what her kitchen dining table should look like. With just a simple
drawing, we were able to create a beautifully formed acrylic base. We used 1″ thick Lucite, formed
and beveled to give this table a bit of finesse. 

## Lucite Closet Shelves

Using Lucite is a great way to display all your personal items in a closet that screams luxury. We
gave our customer a high end 3/4″ thick  Lucite acrylic, custom cut to fit her closet dimensions.
Hand sanded & polish give the finishing touches to make any person smile walking into their closet!

# We are One of Southern California’s Largest Acrylic Distributors.

We have a massive selection of readily available lucite and plexiglass, plus other plastics like
ABS, PETG, high impact styrene, lexan, polycarbonate, rigid vinyl, polyethylene.

How can we help?  [Email us][44] your project details or give us at call at [310-473-5115][45].

[See All][57]

## Celebrating 50 Years in Business!

Solter Plastics has been in business for 50 years, originally started by Bill and Dick Solter.

Today – “If you can draw it, we can make it!” has become the mantra, with our team at Solter
Plastics working one-on-one with customers to form an amazing relationship. 

A customer’s imagination and ideas combined with our technical expertise bring incredible products
to life.

And with the largest selection of acrylic colors in the United States, we’re known worldwide for our
unique colored glitter and mirrored acrylic sheets. 

Our customers come from everywhere – from commercial businesses, universities and the movie industry
to homeowners and project builders. 

Whether you need a piece of acrylic cut to size for a window,  piece of furniture, or a school
project – we are always willing to help.

We carry clear acrylic from 1/8” to 4” thick, with some of the best fabricators in the industry with
over 20 years of experience working with us.   With our vast inventory of plastic combined with our
talented team of fabricators, there isn’t anything we can’t do!

[Learn More][58]

### Years in Business. Family Operated.

### Projects Completed

## Latest Custom Projects

## Wheel of Fortune 35th Anniversary Cake Topper

Wheel of Fortune’s Art team contacted Solter Plastics to design a memorable cake topper to
commemorate their 35 year anniversary of the show. 
We laser cut metallic gold and silver acrylic and laminated to a frosted clear background.

## Luxury Lucite Dining Table

Our customer Ann had a vision of what her kitchen dining table should look like. With just a simple
drawing, we were able to create a beautifully formed acrylic base. We used 1″ thick Lucite, formed
and beveled to give this table a bit of finesse. 

## Lucite Closet Shelves

Using Lucite is a great way to display all your personal items in a closet that screams luxury. We
gave our customer a high end 3/4″ thick  Lucite acrylic, custom cut to fit her closet dimensions.
Hand sanded & polish give the finishing touches to make any person smile walking into their closet!

## Customer Testimonials

super excited with how nice they look”

were able to replicate the polycarbonate plastic. They were kind, fast, and informative, and great
pricing! Highly recommended and will come here next time.”

**Astro Scrambler**

“What a great place! They have lucite/acrylic sheets in at least 25 colors and can make anything you
can conceive of out of it.”

## About Us

Store Supply Warehouse has been serving the retail and small business industries for over 30 years.
We provide the very best in store fixtures and supplies for small businesses, online retailers,
boutiques and more. Whether you are looking for a full line of retail bags and packaging, clothing
racks, hangers, jewelry supplies, display cases and more, storesupply.com is always open to get you
what you need to start or maintain your business. 

The Store Supply Warehouse philosophy is very simple. “Take care of the customer every time without
hesitation.” We are devoted to delivering complete customer satisfaction by way of respect,
knowledge and teamwork. We offer the lowest prices guaranteed anywhere, and with our super fast
shipping, we are able to get you what your business needs when you need it.  Let Store Supply
Warehouse help you build the store of your dreams!

### Blog

Stay updated with the latest retail trends, ideas, and success stories. Our blog shares practical
insights for store owners and e-commerce retailers — from in-store merchandising to online growth
strategies — to help you run a smarter, more successful business.

## About Us

Store Supply Warehouse has been serving the retail and small business industries for over 30 years.
We provide the very best in store fixtures and supplies for small businesses, online retailers,
boutiques and more. Whether you are looking for a full line of retail bags and packaging, clothing
racks, hangers, jewelry supplies, display cases and more, storesupply.com is always open to get you
what you need to start or maintain your business. 

The Store Supply Warehouse philosophy is very simple. “Take care of the customer every time without
hesitation.” We are devoted to delivering complete customer satisfaction by way of respect,
knowledge and teamwork. We offer the lowest prices guaranteed anywhere, and with our super fast
shipping, we are able to get you what your business needs when you need it.  Let Store Supply
Warehouse help you build the store of your dreams!

### Blog

Stay updated with the latest retail trends, ideas, and success stories. Our blog shares practical
insights for store owners and e-commerce retailers — from in-store merchandising to online growth
strategies — to help you run a smarter, more successful business.

## The Ultimate Guide to Premium Surfaces:
## PMMA Acrylic vs. Traditional Laminates

Choosing the right surfacing material is the most critical decision when planning modern modular
kitchens, premium bedroom wardrobes, and high-end commercial interiors. This technical breakdown
explores why architects and interior designers are transitioning away from local manually-applied
laminates (sunmica) to German-bonded prelaminated PMMA acrylic panels.

🧪

### Optical-Grade PMMA Polymer Chemistry

Unlike cheap PVC foils or thin PETG plastics that fade and yellow in bright Indian sunlight,
SurajWood uses **optical-grade Polymethyl Methacrylate (PMMA)** polymer sheets. PMMA is an organic
compound that is 100% UV-stable, meaning white shutters stay perfectly white for over 10 years
without yellowing.

With an organic molecular structure, PMMA delivers a depth of color and mirror-like 95% light
reflectivity that printed laminates (commonly known as mica or sunmica) cannot replicate. Its
non-porous surface is highly hygienic, preventing bacterial or fungal growth in humid areas.

⚙️

### The German PUR Hotmelt Lamination Edge

A premium surface is only as good as its bonding agent. Standard local workshop carpentry relies on
manual contact adhesives (rubber-based) or PVAc glue (white glue) pasted by hand. Under India's
heavy monsoons and high kitchen heat, these local adhesives break down, causing the laminate to
bubble, warp, or peel.

At our fully automated facility in Bahadurgarh, Haryana, SurajWood laminates PMMA sheets onto
premium E1-grade MDF and calibrated plywood using **German Polyurethane Reactive (PUR) Hotmelt**.
PUR hotmelt cures via atmospheric moisture, creating an irreversible cross-linked bond. It
guarantees **zero delamination** and heat resistance up to 120°C.

💎

### 3H Scratch Hardness & Buff-Repairability

Indian modular kitchens are highly active spaces, subject to constant friction from stainless steel
pots, heavy spices, and frequent cooking prep. Traditional laminates scratch easily and, once
scratched, must be completely replaced.

SurajWood panels feature a hardened surface tested to **3H pencil scratch hardness** (compliant with
EN ISO 15184). In the rare event of a superficial scratch, our PMMA acrylic has a unique advantage:
it is **buff-repairable**. Using a standard acrylic polishing compound and soft microfiber cloth,
homeowners can easily buff out micro-scratches, restoring the mirror shine in minutes.

### Premium Applications: Kitchens, Wardrobes, & Wall Panels

Surfacing choices define the physical longevity of your home furniture. When designing modular
kitchens, PMMA acrylic sheets are the ideal specification for shutters and drawer fronts. Given the
high-heat exposure from gas hobs and steam from dishwashers, our waterproof, PUR-bonded boards
prevent the core wood from swelling or warping.

For bedroom wardrobes and walk-in closets, large vertical surfaces demand absolute flatness. Cheaper
laminates often showcase a wavy "orange peel" texture when viewed under direct light. SurajWood's
precision-calibrated backing balancer sheets ensure that all high-gloss and matte wardrobe doors
stay 100% straight and flat over decades of daily door-handling.

Our advanced **ACRYMATTE** and **ACRYSILK** series feature **nano anti-fingerprint coatings** that
scatter light reflections. This keeps handle-less sliding wardrobes and drawers completely
smudge-free even in active households with young children.

## Checkout some FAQs about Custom Fabrication

### Can you create custom shapes and sizes for acrylic?

Absolutely! At T&T Plastic Land, we specialize in cutting acrylic to your exact specifications.
Whether you’re looking for circles, ovals, polygons, or unique, irregular shapes, we’ve got you
covered.

For straight cuts, you can conveniently place your order on our website, and in most cases, your
acrylic will be ready for shipping or pickup on the same day, ensuring your project moves swiftly
and accurately. To get started, simply visit our [Sheets & Circles page][51], where you can place
your order with ease. For inquiries about irregular shapes, please visit our [Custom Acrylic
Fabrication page][52] for more information. Lead time on irregular shapes can vary dependent on the
scope of the project.

### How does the custom fabrication process work?

At T&T Plastic Land, the custom fabrication process is straightforward. To get started, simply email
us, or visit our [Custom Fabrication page][53] and provide a drawing or sketch with your project’s
specifications. We don’t need a technical drawing; just include as much detail as possible.

Once we receive your request, our dedicated team will promptly review it and provide you with a
quote, usually on the same day. If you’re ready to proceed, all we need is your payment to kickstart
the project and turn your vision into reality.

### What types of files do you accept for Laser Cutting and CNC routing services?

To ensure a smooth process for providing a quote and completing your project, we require a vector
file. Accepted file formats include EPS, Adobe Illustrator AI, PDF, or CorelDraw CDR. Additionally,
it’s preferable for all artwork to be provided at a 1:1 Scale to ensure accurate results.

For more information on our [Laser Cutting][54] and [CNC Routing][55] services, please visit our
respective pages.

### How long does it typically take to complete custom fabrication projects?

The lead time for custom fabrication projects can vary depending on our current workflow and the
scope of your order. We make every effort to accommodate our clients’ needs promptly to meet the
deadline.

## Checkout some FAQs about Custom Fabrication

### Can you create custom shapes and sizes for acrylic?

Absolutely! At T&T Plastic Land, we specialize in cutting acrylic to your exact specifications.
Whether you’re looking for circles, ovals, polygons, or unique, irregular shapes, we’ve got you
covered.

For straight cuts, you can conveniently place your order on our website, and in most cases, your
acrylic will be ready for shipping or pickup on the same day, ensuring your project moves swiftly
and accurately. To get started, simply visit our [Sheets & Circles page][51], where you can place
your order with ease. For inquiries about irregular shapes, please visit our [Custom Acrylic
Fabrication page][52] for more information. Lead time on irregular shapes can vary dependent on the
scope of the project.

### How does the custom fabrication process work?

At T&T Plastic Land, the custom fabrication process is straightforward. To get started, simply email
us, or visit our [Custom Fabrication page][53] and provide a drawing or sketch with your project’s
specifications. We don’t need a technical drawing; just include as much detail as possible.

Once we receive your request, our dedicated team will promptly review it and provide you with a
quote, usually on the same day. If you’re ready to proceed, all we need is your payment to kickstart
the project and turn your vision into reality.

### What types of files do you accept for Laser Cutting and CNC routing services?

To ensure a smooth process for providing a quote and completing your project, we require a vector
file. Accepted file formats include EPS, Adobe Illustrator AI, PDF, or CorelDraw CDR. Additionally,
it’s preferable for all artwork to be provided at a 1:1 Scale to ensure accurate results.

For more information on our [Laser Cutting][54] and [CNC Routing][55] services, please visit our
respective pages.

### How long does it typically take to complete custom fabrication projects?

The lead time for custom fabrication projects can vary depending on our current workflow and the
scope of your order. We make every effort to accommodate our clients’ needs promptly to meet the
deadline.

## Acrylic Sheet Manufacturing Capabilities

At Weacrylic, we have a variety of manufacturing processes to enrich our acrylic sheet products. We
have acrylic extrusion, acrylic casting, laser cutting, silk printing and thermoforming, and can
manufacture acrylic parts for you. Also, we can do anti-fog, super abrasion, anti-glare, and other

We use high-quality raw materials to fabricate our acrylic products unique and suitable for the

manufacturer, Weacrylic is your best choice.

## 1. Acrylic Sheets Extruding

First, we pour the acrylic material into the machine to melt it. Next, the material is poured into a
mold and then fed into an extruder for heating. Finally, it is cooled to form a fixed shape.

In conclusion, extrusion acrylic panel is a continuous production process. And it is easy to bend
and thermoform. Meanwhile, extruded acrylic has a better tolerance for thickness.

[acrylic sheets extruding]
[cast acrylic sheet China manufacturer]

## 2. Acrylic Sheets Casting

Cast acrylic is a form of acrylic material. It is produced by mixing the acrylic liquid ingredients
in molds. Firstly, we pour the liquid ingredients into a mold made from glass plates in the
production process. Then the mold is submerged in warm water. Here the polymerization process takes
place.

In conclusion, the cast acrylic panel is more chemical resistant when compared to extruded acrylic
materials. After laser cutting, there are no burrs in the edges of the cast perspex sheet.
Therefore, it gives polished edges. In addition, cast acrylic board is available in a wide variety
of colors.

## 3. Laser Cutting Acrylic Panels

Laser cutting is a method of cutting specific designs in acrylic materials. In other words, it
involves using lasers to cut or engrave. Our laser cutting equipment can cut any shape and size you
want. In addition, it leaves a smooth edge after the acrylic is melted, burned, or vaporized.

Our laser cutting equipment is advanced, and it can meet your any cutting needs. At the same time,
we provide customized acrylic board services and products.

## 4. Screen Printing on Acrylic Sheet

Screen printing on acrylic is a important technology. It is the process of transferring ink onto the
acrylic substrate through a mesh. Then using a squeegee/roller to fill the open apertures.It is
useful and very relevant for printing labels, logos, and texts.

In addition, we can apply many print coatings on acrylic sheets. They can enhance resistance,
anti-fogging, glare reduction and solar reflexivity. In conclusion, it is common in many acrylic
fabrication applications.The applications are very appealing.

## Acrylic Sheet Manufacturing Capabilities

At Weacrylic, we have a variety of manufacturing processes to enrich our acrylic sheet products. We
have acrylic extrusion, acrylic casting, laser cutting, silk printing and thermoforming, and can
manufacture acrylic parts for you. Also, we can do anti-fog, super abrasion, anti-glare, and other
unique surface treatments to acrylic products.

We use high-quality raw materials to fabricate our acrylic products unique and suitable for the
needs of different customers. Therefore, if you are looking for a professional one-stop acrylic
manufacturer, Weacrylic is your best choice.

## 1. Acrylic Sheets Extruding

First, we pour the acrylic material into the machine to melt it. Next, the material is poured into a
mold and then fed into an extruder for heating. Finally, it is cooled to form a fixed shape.

In conclusion, extrusion acrylic panel is a continuous production process. And it is easy to bend
and thermoform. Meanwhile, extruded acrylic has a better tolerance for thickness.

[acrylic sheets extruding]
[cast acrylic sheet China manufacturer]

## 2. Acrylic Sheets Casting

Cast acrylic is a form of acrylic material. It is produced by mixing the acrylic liquid ingredients
in molds. Firstly, we pour the liquid ingredients into a mold made from glass plates in the
production process. Then the mold is submerged in warm water. Here the polymerization process takes
place.

In conclusion, the cast acrylic panel is more chemical resistant when compared to extruded acrylic
materials. After laser cutting, there are no burrs in the edges of the cast perspex sheet.
Therefore, it gives polished edges. In addition, cast acrylic board is available in a wide variety
of colors.

## 3. Laser Cutting Acrylic Panels

Laser cutting is a method of cutting specific designs in acrylic materials. In other words, it
involves using lasers to cut or engrave. Our laser cutting equipment can cut any shape and size you
want. In addition, it leaves a smooth edge after the acrylic is melted, burned, or vaporized.

Our laser cutting equipment is advanced, and it can meet your any cutting needs. At the same time,
we provide customized acrylic board services and products.

Screen printing on acrylic is a important technology. It is the process of transferring ink onto the
acrylic substrate through a mesh. Then using a squeegee/roller to fill the open apertures.It is
useful and very relevant for printing labels, logos, and texts.

In addition, we can apply many print coatings on acrylic sheets. They can enhance resistance,
anti-fogging, glare reduction and solar reflexivity. In conclusion, it is common in many acrylic
fabrication applications.The applications are very appealing.

[ FAQ ][138]
[ Warmly welcome your inquiry and coming. We believe that cooperation with us will be pleasant,
pragmatic, efficient and honest. ][139]
Q:

Do you offer custom design?

A:

Absolutely! Our structures can be customized to suit your specific needs from components to size to
colors, almost everything is customizable. If you provide drawings or specifications, it is our
pleasure to provide a unique design to you for free, so please feel free to consult us.

Q:

What is the delivery time?

A:

Delivery time depends on order quantity and designs. Usually, it takes about 10-35 days after
deposit done.

Q:

What is the minimum order quantity?

A:

Usually, MOQ is 10 sets for outdoor furniture, if you need a sample to test, we support 1 set. For
Restaurant table and chairs, MOQ is 100pcs. MOQ is different for different products, you can contact
us directly for MOQ, and we will try our best to help you open the local market.

Q:

How do you guarantee the quality?

A:

We have our own inspection team, every product will pass the rigorous quality inspection to ensure
everything is completely before shipping. We will take the responsibility for any quality problems
caused by us.

## How It Works

From first message to finished product — five steps, fully transparent.
1. 1
   Day 0
   
   ### Share Design
   
   Send a CAD file, sketch, photo, or reference image with dimensions and quantity. No design file?
   A photo and rough dimensions are enough to start.
2. 2
   24h
   
   ### Get Quote
   
   Our team reviews your specs and sends a detailed quote with material options, finishing choices,
   and pricing breakdown. No hidden fees. No vague estimates.
3. 3
   3–5 days
   
   ### Approve Sample
   
   We build a production sample for your review. What you approve is exactly what we produce — no
   surprises between sample and bulk.
4. 4
   15–20 days
   
   ### Production
   
   Your order enters our 5,000 m² facility. 8 laser cutters, 4 CNC machines, dedicated polishing
   lines. Every piece passes 100% inspection before packing.
5. 5
   FOB / CIF / DDP
   
   ### Delivery
   
   FOB Shenzhen (default), or we handle CIF/DDP if you prefer door-to-door. Full shipping
   documentation included.

## Manufacturing Capabilities

Our 5,000 m² Shenzhen facility houses 8 laser cutters, 4 CNC machines, and a dedicated diamond
polishing line. From raw PMMA sheet to finished, inspected product, every step stays in-house — no
outsourcing, no quality gaps.

[Laser Cutting]

### Laser Cutting

Clean, precise edges every time — tolerances under 0.1mm, independent of sheet thickness

[CNC Machining]

### CNC Machining

Complex 3D shapes, precision drilling, and custom hardware integration — no geometry is off-limits

[Diamond Polishing]

### Diamond Polishing

Edges so clear they look like glass — brings out acrylic's natural transparency

[Thermoforming]

### Thermoforming

Smooth curves and custom shapes, heat-bent without joints or visible seams

[UV Printing]

### UV Printing

Full-color, photo-quality graphics printed directly on acrylic — vibrant and durable

[Assembly]

### Assembly

Multi-part bonding, hardware installation, and complete assembly — your order ships ready to use

Our Solutions

ACEY specializes in providing comprehensive battery equipment and solution services, ranging from
laboratory battery research and pilot-scale battery production to battery pack assembly. Our
portfolio includes turnkey laboratory and pilot line solutions for coin, cylindrical, and pouch
cells; battery cell and pack testing solutions; and both semi-automatic and fully-automatic battery
pack assembly lines for cylindrical, prismatic, and pouch batteries.

  [FULLY-AUTOMATIC BATTERY PACK ASSEMBLY LINE][246] [[FULLY-AUTOMATIC BATTERY PACK ASSEMBLY
  LINE]][247]

  prismatic battery applications, including home ESS, commercial & industrial ESS, telecommunication
  base stations, UPS, AGVs, and electric vehicles (EV). Compatible with mainstream 100Ah to 314Ah+
  cell specifications, we deliver a full-process solution spanning cell sorting, precision stacking,
  high-accuracy laser welding, casing assembly, to air tightness and EOL comprehensive testing, with
  seamless MES system integration for full lifecycle data traceability. Based on your specific
  product structure, factory layout, and capacity requirements in the ESS, commercial, or motive
  power fields, we provide deep customization services.

  cleaning machine, Laser welding machine, BMS Tester, Battery comprehensive tester and Battery pack
  tester, etc.

Our Solutions

ACEY specializes in providing comprehensive battery equipment and solution services, ranging from
laboratory battery research and pilot-scale battery production to battery pack assembly. Our
portfolio includes turnkey laboratory and pilot line solutions for coin, cylindrical, and pouch
cells; battery cell and pack testing solutions; and both semi-automatic and fully-automatic battery
pack assembly lines for cylindrical, prismatic, and pouch batteries.

* [[FULLY-AUTOMATIC BATTERY PACK ASSEMBLY LINE]][245]
  [FULLY-AUTOMATIC BATTERY PACK ASSEMBLY LINE][246] [[FULLY-AUTOMATIC BATTERY PACK ASSEMBLY
  LINE]][247]
  ACEY provides one-stop solutions for the fully automatic battery pack assembly line of diversified
  prismatic battery applications, including home ESS, commercial & industrial ESS, telecommunication
  base stations, UPS, AGVs, and electric vehicles (EV). Compatible with mainstream 100Ah to 314Ah+
  cell specifications, we deliver a full-process solution spanning cell sorting, precision stacking,
  high-accuracy laser welding, casing assembly, to air tightness and EOL comprehensive testing, with
  seamless MES system integration for full lifecycle data traceability. Based on your specific
  product structure, factory layout, and capacity requirements in the ESS, commercial, or motive
  power fields, we provide deep customization services.

  capacity grading Machine, Battery sorting machine, Battery stacking and pressing machine, Laser
  cleaning machine, Laser welding machine, BMS Tester, Battery comprehensive tester and Battery pack

  Grading Machine, Insulation Paper Sticking Machine, Battery Sorting Machine, CCD tester,
